As part of the HR Operations organization, the HR Operations Specialist will deliver first line support and day-to-day direction to the complete HR team in EMEA or other stakeholders.  The HR Operations Specialist is the first point of contact for our employees and they will respond to employee inquiries, by providing support, advice, problem solving, identifying solutions and escalates as needed. This position requires good judgment and extreme initiative and is accountable for the quality and productivity of requests.  The HR Operations team acts as a bridge between employees and other departments e.g. Payroll, Benefits, Finance, HR Partners, etc. 

What You’ll Do

- First point of contact for our employees for all their inquiries and concerns; providing guidance, advice, problem-solving and coaching throughout their employee experience at Tesla

- HR Administration/HR Operations experience is a plus; ideally in a customer-facing environment

jobs.occupation: Mechanical Design Engineer, Sealing (m/w/d) Berlin Germany (Data Engineer)
jobs.description:
What to Expect

As a Closures Sealing Engineer, you will work with some of the industry’s brightest minds and take engineering ownership of complete static and dynamic sealing systems as well as Daylight Opening trims for Tesla vehicles. Your work will focus on static and dynamic seals for current vehicle programs, with an emphasis on quality improvement, cost reduction, and manufacturing enhancements. Additionally, you will be responsible for the engineering and design of static and dynamic seals and DLO trims for future vehicle programs.   Your ownership of seals will include initiating and overseeing both virtual (CAE) and physical testing and analysis to validate new designs from concept to production. This role provides a great opportunity to interface with all aspects of vehicle development. You will work closely with the body, closures, electrical/firmware, exterior, and interior teams, as well as with manufacturing engineering, to establish world-class seal and trim designs along with world-class assembly processes.  

What You’ll Do

- Serve as a member of the Vehicle Engineering Team, supporting closure system static and dynamic sealing and DLO trim development for Tesla vehicles  
- Fully specify elastomeric seal designs through the creation of specification drawings 
- Initiate seal CAE studies, interpret results, and iterate until geometry and materials meet design targets 
- Select appropriate materials for elastomeric static and dynamic seals and DLO trims 
- Understand manufacturing processes used to produce elastomeric seals, TP & metallic trims, and assembly processes 
- Achieve innovation-driven closure sealing & trims system targets for appearance, function, quality, cost, and weight 
- Establish system level architecture and functionality based on market research, design feasibility and prototyping. Creation of component specifications, and other technical design documents 
- Participate in the iterative process with the Tesla design and styling studio to deliver the optimal balance of form, function, and quality 
- Interpret/develop Tolerance Analysis, CAE, DFM, DFMEA, PFMEA simulations/results and integrate feedback into product designs 
- Manage and collaborate with key suppliers (both internal and external) to support overall vehicle development milestones and prototype/ production build events 

What You’ll Bring

- Degree in Mechanical Engineering or equivalent experience, with evidence of exceptional ability 
- Minimum of 3 years of experience in the design and engineering of static/dynamic seals and exterior trims 
- Strong understanding of GD&T 
- Ability to interpret FEA results and integrate recommendations into product designs 
- Experience designing new and improved seals and trim components using design software 
- Proficiency in CAD software V5/3DX for designing 2D sections and 3D geometry of seals. Experience designing complex seal molds is a plus 
- Proven track record of ownership of seal and trim designs from concept (new or improved) through production 
- Experience collaborating with supply chain partners in the development of new seals and trims 
- Must be proactive in improving processes and driving projects—examples of such initiatives should be provided 
- Excellent communication skills, resourcefulness, and time management Please apply with your CV in English.

Tesla is an Equal Opportunity / Affirmative Action employer committed to diversity in the workplace. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, age, national origin, disability, protected veteran status, gender identity or any other factor protected by applicable federal, state or local laws.

Full-time or part-time | Munich Alt-Bogenhausen

Phorms Campus Munich is a bilingual German-English education campus offering educational programmes from Crèche and Kindergarten through Primary School to Secondary School. Our well-located and lovingly maintained city campus in Munich Alt-Bogenhausen, close to the English Garden, is home to an international school community where children, families and staff feel welcome, supported and valued.

In our bilingual Kindergarten and Crèche, we encourage children to try out new things, respect themselves and others, develop empathy and curiosity, and grow in confidence and independence. In this way, we build a strong foundation for their future education.

For our Kindergarten and Crèche in Munich Alt-Bogenhausen, we are looking for a motivated and qualified Early Years Educator / English-speaking Kindergarten Teacher (all genders) in full-time or part-time.

Your Responsibilities

• Supporting and fostering children in their individual development according to our Early Childhood curriculum
• Creating a warm, safe and stimulating learning environment for children in Crèche and Kindergarten
• Observing, assessing and documenting children’s learning journeys and developmental progress
• Planning and implementing age-appropriate educational activities
• Working closely with parents in a professional and trust-based parent-teacher partnership

• Enjoyment of working with children in Crèche and Kindergarten age groups
• Interest in working in a bilingual and international educational environment
• Team spirit, reliability, responsibility, empathy and motivation
• Valid work permit for Germany, EU citizenship or a residence title allowing employment in Germany

• Subsidised EGYM Wellpass membership

German language skills are not required at the beginning. However, we are looking for candidates who are motivated to learn German and willing to develop their language skills while working in our international environment.

For the International Montessori School **in Berlin-Wannsee **we are looking for an

English-Speaking Primary School Teacher

Ref. Nr. 376DR-BA

Your Employer

Montessori & Friends Education gGmbH is an innovative educational institution that runs several children’s centres, the International Bilingual Montessori Primary School and its own Montessori Academy. These facilities create nurturing learning environments for children based on the educational philosophy of Maria Montessori. At the primary school, 130 children learn in mixed-age groups on the grade-levels 1-6. The historic school building is situated in an idyllic location not far from Lake Wannsee. The opening of a secondary school on the same site is planned for the 2026/27 academic year. The school’s aim is to promote self-directed learning and support the holistic development of the children. Another key focus of the school is bilingual education. Around half of the pupils come from English-speaking or bilingual homes and are taught bilingually from grade 1 in both German and English.

Your Responsibilities

As a teacher, you will guide a maximum of 24 students in mixed-age learning groups (grades 1–3) and provide them with individualized support. You will be actively supported by a co-teacher. You will teach all standard elementary school subjects exclusively in English and work according to the principles of Montessori pedagogy. A trusting partnership with parents is just as important as your own creative freedom.

The school offers you 

- a permanent, full-time position,
- competitive compensation, as well as additional benefits and bonuses,
- Childcare spots for your own children in the school’s own daycare centers and at the school, subject to availability,
- regular professional development opportunities and a chance to gain an internationally recognized Montessori-Diploma,
- a supportive team and a friendly, family-like work environment.

This opportunity is for you if

- you have a teaching qualification recognised in the Federal State of Berlin, such as a Master of Education, a German 2. Staatsexamen für die Grundschule/Sekundarstufe I, a foreign teaching degree, or (N)QTS.
- you have already gained experience teaching English at the primary school level,
- you have a Montessori diploma or practical Montessori experience, and the willingness to earn a Montessori diploma while working at the school,
- you have a minimum of a C1 level in English and a minimum of a B1 level in German,
- you enjoy working in a team and cooperating closely with parents and caregivers.

Have we piqued your interest?

If so, we look forward to receiving your application, including your CV and details of your relevant qualifications. Please send your application, quoting reference number 376DR-BA, via email (info@lehrcare.de) in PDF format, to Dorottya Toth, who will be happy to provide you with further information.
